extension.news: 1.0.0 - Current conditions, hourly forecast for 72 hours and daily forecast for 7 days from the National Weather Service, for up to five US locations - The local forecaster's written forecast for each day and night - Radar and satellite loops centered on your location, forecast highs across the lower 48 states, and a hurricane or severe weather map when one applies - Active NWS alerts for your location - Air quality, UV index, sunrise, sunset and moon phase - Temperatures, wind, times and dates follow your Kodi region settings
extension.summary: US weather from the National Weather Service
extension.description: Weather data from authoritative US government sources. Forecasts from NWS (human-edited by local meteorologists), radar from NWS, UV index and sun times from Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0), air quality from Open-Meteo or AirNow with your own free key. Location search by the US Census geocoder and Nominatim, © OpenStreetMap contributors.
